items.title: Why Reddit (RDDT) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of online community and discussion platform Reddit (NYSE:RDDT) jumped 13.8% in the morning session after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced the social media company will join the S&P 500, replacing AvalonBay Communities (NYSE: AVB), effective prior to the open on Tuesday, August 18.
